name: A Stupid Love Story
source:
A Stupid Love Story is a Homestuck visual novel following the characters Jade Harley and Karkat Vantas through their unconventional courtship.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=16554]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
《愚蠢的愛情故事》是一部《Homestuck》同人視覺小說，講述傑德．哈雷與卡卡特．萬塔斯不同尋常的求愛過程。
